verdict.rationale: New Relic ships explicit deployment marker support (CLI records deploys tied to APM applications) and NRQL/alerting can be layered on top to spot regressions after a deploy, giving the core of deploy-based change tracking. However, there's no evidence of dedicated 'configuration change tracking' beyond deployments, nor of a unified regression-correlation UI/workflow tying alerts directly to deploy markers. Missing for 10: configuration-change event tracking (not just app deploys), an explicit UI/workflow that overlays alerts/regressions against deployment markers, and independent/hands-on confirmation this correlation works well in practice.
